chapter: Newark and first years in Harlem
title: The manager's girl, Jeff Blunt and the dropped music stand
summary: A woman admirer, who was manager Jeff Blunt's girlfriend, forced Butler to her table; when Blunt threatened him he dropped the stand on him, and the bouncer intervened.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: But there was a certain lady, keep coming there, and I'd be up on the bandstand, you know the music stand, well, I would hide behind that thing because I didn't want to be bothered with nobody. And one lady had -- there was a boy, was a dancer, and she had cut him, tried to cut his full dress suit off of him. So I saw that and I knew what to do because I had been on Broom (PHONETIC) Street and I know what could happen to you. So I was just paying attention to my music.

But this girl kept looking up there. And I didn't know she -- the manager, Mr. Jeff Blunt, liked this girl. But I -- I didn't want to be bothered because I had enough -- too much fun there, about to take me out. So for one night she (inaudible) and she became real brazen. She says, "Him, I want him to have something to drink and come on over. No, I want him to have something to drink. And give the band what they wish."

drinking Coca Cola, and very seldom I would drink At that time I was a bit of beer. So she said, well, alright. give the band something. And she said, I want him to come down here at intermission and sit at the table. Everything was) I went to sit at the table. And this little man, got up and) said, "Well, you little punk, you, I'm going to knock you down." And I said, "Well, Mr. Blunt, what are you doing?" And I got a chair.... said, "Mr. Blunt," He went and) But he just conducted. I dropped the stand on Mr. Blunt. The stand fell down, Mr. Blunt fell down.

And they had a big, old bouncer, his name was Paul. He says, Mr. Blunt, the boy, the kid didn't mean nothing and you're going to hurt him. (Unintelligible). And this girl said, "I'm going to pay you your salary now."
